nom: TULA Detox in a Jar Exfoliating Treatment Mask

avis.texte: I love this product so much, it feels so good during application and processing time. It isn't too abrasive, and yet my pores come out so clean. It doesn't feel like my skin is being stripped away. I have an average amount of oily skin for reference.
I love rhis exfoliating mask. I use this about 3 times a week and love the way my face feels awfterwards. So refreshing and clean. Pair it up with any other tula products you wont be disappointed!
My mom got me the travel sized so I could try it and its amazing! It leaves my skin super soft and shiny, it doesnt dry out my skin!! Overall great product and will be buying this more! 😁

avis.titre: Wish I could do zero stars
avis.texte: As a licensed estie, I was always skeptical about this product, but one of my cliente swears by it. I finally tried it, & it was terrible. It clogged my pores in all of my t-zone. Washed if off, & lightly exfoliated with it (like directions say) & you could see little blue dots all over my face. Completely in my pores. I had to exfoliate MORE & use an extractor to get some out. Here is to reparing my skin barrier because of this product !!! Definitely not "detox in a jar"
Literally the best mask I have ever used. Great for when you see a break out starting, after travel in airports etc and if you are oily this helps to balance.
Best exfoliating product I have ever used! I have sensitive skin and it does not irritate my skin. It leaves my skin deeply cleaned and smooth.

avis.titre: Best exfoliating and pore purifying mask ever!!!
avis.texte: This stuff is INCREDIBLE! My face feels softer than ever, and normally clay masks leave my skin feeling tight and dry. This did not. This stuff exfoliated my skin thoroughly, and gently. I also actually felt like my pores were thoroughly purified.

avis.titre: One of my favorite Tula p
avis.texte: One of my favorite Tula products. Makes my skin feel so smooth.

avis.titre: Good quick mask that helps with acne and dullness
avis.texte: This mask is actually pretty good. It leaves my skin feeling really soft and does some mild exfoliation. It helps with dullness. I've been using it for a number of years and continue to use it and like how it makes my skin feel and look. Like the Bentonite clay it helps with acne.

First time trying this exfoliating mask. It has a light fresh scent and a little goes a long way. This mask in particular gets rid of the excess sebum I have on my chin. Even the bumps that were there are pretty much gone. The bumps on my cheeks are gone too and my face feels a whole lot smoother. My skin is not as oily throughout the day and my foundation went on evenly and lasted much longer. I plan to keep using this.
This is second product I have used from this company and I am not impressed. It smells like an old lady. It comes in a jar making it messy. And my texture hasnt improved.

I recently purchased several Tula products and they were all bad but this one was extra bad. Leaves a waxy feeling on your skin. No matter how many times I rinsed my face, I still had little pieces of the "scrub" stuck to my face. Once I was finally done, I had a white cast on my skin so I had to rewash my face. I did not notice a clearing of pores or other deep cleanse. If this was a cheaper product I might expect it but at almost $50 for the tub this is a travesty of a face product.
it looks great looks like it would work but does not come off easily. doesn't really exfoliate feel like wax. Feels like it just sits on the skin doesn't do anything.
it looks great looks like it would work but does not come off easily. doesn't really exfoliate feel like wax. Feels like it just sits on the skin doesn't do anything.
I have used this exfoliating mask 1-2 times a week for over a year. Love how it makes my face feel so smooth and looks refreshed It's a game changer in my skin routine.
Love how it feels on my skin and definitely helps with redness and existing acne.

This is my favorite exfoliating treatment mask. the blue color was a little worrying as some dyes damage my skin. no issues with this! it's got a nice cooling feeling and the exfoliating beads feel great. i was worried the size was too small but a little goes a long way and the jar lasts.

avis.titre: Makes my skin feel soft but leaves a horrible white-cast
avis.texte: I bought this scrub thinking it was a chemical exfoliant but it definitely felt more like a "scrub". The texture was nice and smelled really nice but when Iwashed it off, it leaves a pretty bad white cast almost greasy film. I had to rewash my face to get it off. I wouldn't buy this again.

Loved the feel of my skin after using it. It felt refreshed and so soft and smooth to the touch. I immediately called my daughter-in-law; she ordered it as well. I'm new to your products. I am a fan!!!
This mask is amazing! My skin feels so soft after every use. Fine lines and pies pores are less visible every time I use it :+1::blush:
I LOVE THIS MASK. My skin felt so clean and I just felt brand new after using it!!!
I love how my skin feels after use, so smooth and very refreshed. It has the perfect amount of exfoliation and it smells good!
Great stuff, tingled and feels cool upon application and skin feels clean and clear after.

This is my go to clay mask. It works at deeply exfoliating and breaking dead skin. The white cast it leaves behind during the first use is from the face already being dirty as most face cleaners only clean the first layer of the skin. Plus the cast goes away within an hour after first use so be sure to use it at night time. I could definitely feel and see the difference the next day while in the sun in addition to my facial moisturizer. My face had a very soft shine too it.
I love this mask. My face is instantly brighter and softer every time I use it.
The mask leaves a white cast on your face. Had to use another exfoliating product to get it off. I tried it two different times and got the same result. Will be returning

avis.titre: A must in my skincare routine
avis.texte: I slack on my skincare routine from time to time and this is my saving Grace. I have combination skin and if I get lazy my skin breaks out, flaky skin that gets oily and looks awful. I use this once and it's like I'm a whole new woman! Removes all my dry skin with ease and feels great while doing it. My skin is smooth and glowing after each use. I recommend this to all my friends.

I have never seen my skin this smooth, ever. The very next day I woke up with a glow that I have never seen before and it almost brought me to tears because, for the first time in a VERY long time, my skin just looked...happy ❤️ First Tula product to ever try...definitely caught my attention.(also, I have combination skin with mild to moderate cystic acne.)

I love this exfoliating treatment mask. The size of the container is the same size as the 24/7 lotion. It goes feels nice on the skin and it's a great quality. When it was time to wash it off, it was such a gentle exfoliation. I definitely noticed a difference and it helped even out my skin tone. I will definitely buy it again.

i have sensitive, combo, acne prone skin. aka my skin is impossible. i'm always very hesitant to try new products but am going through purging at the moment and felt my skin needed a little boost so i decided to try this out. WOW. this didn't break me out, and left my skin feeling so balanced. face masks geared toward acne usually make my skin feel so dry but this stuff is unreal. i feel like it really helped clear my purging gunk out of the way. highly highly recommend.

This mask is so lovely. I was looking for a good quick and easy cleansing mask for the shower and this is it!!! I cleanse my face with micellar water and then put this one right one right before I get in. It tingles at first but after it has a wonderful cooling effect. You can feel it cleaning!!! After 2 uses it cleared up my few breakouts and brightened my skin. So worth the money !!!!! PS be careful opening it though. I accidentally busted it all over. Luckily, Ulta (being the lovely company they are) exchanged it without any issue.

I have very dry, acne prone skin. This mask is everything that I hopped it would be. It does not dry out my skin. It brightens my face because it cleanses it so well. And my acne doesn't last as long! My skin is sooooooo soft it seriously is amazing. 100% would recommend!
Exfoliating Mask - Tula - 1st time I used mask - your face feels soo clean

By far the best mask I've used. I love the little exfoliating beads that are in it, I can really feel it working when I use it. My face is significantly softer and smoother. I am a nurse, so I wear a mask for long periods of times at work, this mask was recommended to me by a coworker and man am I glad I got it. Super refreshing after a long 12 hour shift. Detox in a jar is defiantly a good name for this product!

I was applying the mask and it instantly started to burn my face. I immediately washed it off. My right cheek was super tender after and it felt like I waa sun burned. I was so excited to try it also, sad day.
I love the texture of this stuff, and the fact that it only needs to be on for a few mins. The minty feeling while it's working is a nice plus.

The mask is okay. I was waiting for the refreshing feel after removing it off my face. I also found it difficult to remove off my face, I am not sure if leaving it past the time (not by intention) had something to do with it. Not wowed and will not be using it again.
I have only used the product 2 times but it has really helped my skin feel smooth and clean. It has helped reduce my acne blemishes significantly.

Easy application, doesn't burn or irritate, but I don't see a ton of exfoliation results. This would be great for those looking for gentle exfoliation. My skin does feel healthier after use but I think I'll try something more intense once I'm done with the jar.

I suffer from adult acne & condo skin. This mask has helped so much with both!! I love a quick mask that works!! My pores have reduced in size & my skin is clear & smooth! Plus the mask is not drying at all. So good!!
After 5 seconds of having this mask on my skin, it instantly started to burn. I couldn't keep it on. I personally prefer the Claydate mask to this one.
This product makes my face feel good. I'm glad I purchased it.
I use this twice a week! Helps with preventing breakouts from having to wear a mask all day at work. One of my favorite products!

Just got this for first time and never used a product like this before since I'm new to skin care. Just wow! It works so well! After doing it my skin looks so much cleaner and healthy and feels soft too! definitely recommend!

Absolutely in love with this mask! It clears your pores so well and leaves the skin feeling refreshed, bright, and smooth. Bought this right before my summer trip and barely wore any makeup on the entire vacation because my skin felt so great. It especially works well if you have blackheads/whiteheads or oily zones.
I LOVE THIS PRODUCT!! My skin feels refreshed and looks better than ever. I have occasional breakouts and this product has helped so much in preventing them!
I was using another exfoliating mask but this one is a lot more affective. I feel like this product is a lot more affective.

I loved the feeling of this mask from the moment I put it on my face to the moment I washed it off! Not only does it feel great on my skin but my skin post mask is so soft & absolutely glowing! My fiancée loves how happy Tula makes me that he doesn't care we (I) own every Tula product out there. Ladies get the product(s), your S.O will love how happy it makes you!!!!

avis.titre: Okay but leaves a white residue on my face
avis.texte: I like it but like other people have said it burns a little bit and it leaves a white residue on my face that TAKES FOREVER to wash off. That's probably the main reason I won't buy it again :(((

I used to be obsessed with lush face masks. where I live now there is no lush and I was struggling to find a face mask that would work for me as well as theirs did. This face mask does the trick. My skin is more even tones, acne is clearing up. I am beyond happy with it. I also have very sensitive skin so most products will break me out more and turn my skin red, this one does the opposite. I do have a bit of a burning tingling sensation when washing it off. I follow up with a toner and lotion and I'm good to go.
This mask feels great and definitely took out a couple blemishes that had formed during my period. Love it
I'm not too sure what to think of it yet..used it a couple times now. It does kinda feel like it's burning for a little bit, maybe my face is too sensitive for it? Or maybe it's suppose to burn?

I religiously used Tula products before they were even popular or well known and unfortunately I had to stop using most of their products because it seemed like the more popular they became the less clean ingredients they were adding and my sensitive skin was not having it... with that being said I still religiously use this mask... it's my all time favorite, it's super refreshing, light and clears acne. Also, a lot goes a long way!

My boyfriend & I have been using this mask weekly for about a month. He has sensitive skin (I don't) but neither one of us have had a bad reaction to this. This mask makes your face been soft & so clean!
Tingles and slightly burns, but I feel like that means it's working! Kind of reminds me of icy hot.
I have really bad blackheads and deep pores this is amazing and gets down and cleans them out!

While it did leave my face super soft and clean, this mask burns my face. I can only stand to leave it on for less than one minute. I do have sensitive skin, but I didn't know my skin was THAT sensitive.

I use this 2 times a week (Wednesdays and Saturdays). It temporarily works one the night I use it because it does rid of the dead skin cells that are lying on the skin. It does also makes my pores smaller but only after the use, it doesn't improve over time after using it. Overall, it's a typical exfoiliant that aids in ridding dead skin cells but any type would do this for less money.
Great exfoliator! My skin feels instantly smoother and clean.
This mask is high quality and has kept my hormone acne in check while being pregnant. My skin feels amazing after and it smells great!

This is a great scrub! It does a nice job of exfoliating the skin. I use it every other week, but could definitely use it more. It's easy to use and doesn't irritate my skin. A good exfoliator is always good to have in your skin care routine!

I was hesitant to purchase this product because of the price but I finally gave in. I put it on before a bath and rinsed it off afterward. My skin immediately felt softer and was glowing. I usually prefer chemical exfoliants but this one is gentle and didn't feel harsh on my face at all. Worth every penny.

Great exfoliant and mask in one. It's also pretty hydrating - doesn't dry out like most masks and doesn't leave my skin feeling dry either. I love to use it right before bed when I'm having a bad break out week. Works wonders. Also a small amount of it goes a really long way.
This is the best Exfoliating mask I've tried to date. Love that it's a duo as a mask and exfoliating for clean and clear complexions

I have very sensitive skin with redness, large pores, and blackheads. Lately have had some complications due to retinoids and other treatments. I needed a gentle but effective way to exfoliate and this went above and beyond. My skin was brighter after just one use. With continued use over the next two weeks, I saw a dramatic improvement in pore size and the blackheads are gone and staying away. It literally looks like I have a primer on when I look in the mirror, but all I have on is lotion. It's because the mask has been working so well. And I feel like my skin is brighter and also less red. Lactic acid is a great chemical exfoliant for sensitive skin. The corn meal in this also provides a gentle physical exfoliant because it doesn't have the sharp edges of other physical exfoliators that can leave micro tears in the skin. Bentonite Clay does such a great job at sucking all of the gunk out. I make some of my own skin care products and normally I would complain about the cost of this but for me it has been worth every penny. Would give this more stars if I could and will continue to repurchase.
Easy to apply, doesn't tighten like other masks, easy to remove. The results are amazing! My skin is so soft.
I've used this mask a few times so far, it always leaves my skin feeling clean and soft.
This mask is great! Doesn't dry your skin out like some masks. Love the exfoliation it gives as well!!
I like it so far, but didn't pull blackheads out as much as I'd like. I maybe should have waited for the clay date mask to come out.

The treatment mask has a very "cooling" effect when you apply it, it also smells super fresh! I've only used it 3 times so far but I can definitely tell it's great for my skin! I would absolutely recommend this product!
I enjoy this as a part of my every other day ritual. I recommend this product.

I'm sure this is a wonderful product for most but for those that have super sensitive skin, Do Not Try!!! This burns really bad and usually I'll deal with the burn but this one I couldn't even last 10 seconds of rubbing it on. My skin burned for awhile after washing it off as well. No go for sensitive skin!!!

Great mask for purging pores of dirt, etc. I love that it only takes about 5 minutes to dry after application making it a quick an easy addition to my skincare routine. My face appears clearer and softer after approximately one month of use. There is a tingling/cooling effect when first applied. But comparable to a mask like GlamGlow's Super Clearing Mud it is not as intense. A little goes a long way. I will repurchase this mask.
I can tell the texture of my face different, much smoother. My pores are smaller. Love the product.

I just started my second tub of this mask; it smells great and makes your skin SO soft! I put the mask on and then scrub and wash it off in the shower. The scrubbing feels so good, you can almost feel the dull and dead skin being buffed away especially in the cold and dry winter season. 10/10 highly recommend!

I've been using Tula for 3 weeks now and I can't even tell you how in love I am with this brand! Everyone tells me how clear and radiant my skin has been looking! I'm 32 and just began my story of skincare routines, but I'm here for it!! Tula saved my skin!
My face felt balanced with moisture afterwards and softer than normal.
Love this mask! It left my face feeling clean, soft and hydrated!

i'm not a big mask person but i bought this on a whim and it is honestly amazing. makes your skin tingle and feel like it's legit detoxing. when u take it off it feels like weights been lifted off your face. the price is high but it's worth it when you're doing this once a week.
I love this mask! Gently exfoliates without being too drying. You only need 3-5 minutes with it! Skin is smooth and soft after use and it's gentle enough to use a few times per week.
This reminds me of my favorite drugstore mask from when I was a teen but it's less drying and exfoliating! Love it!
In love with this product!! I use it 2-3x per week as instructed and wow my face looks so smooth and healthy after. It really helps with calm redness and irritation. One of my Tula favs!
This mask is amazing! I love the tingling and how my skin feels after.. but the smell.... the smell is like new paint, mixed with hair dye. Very weird smell, and it's a little overpowering.

I have oily acne prone skin. Also in my late 20's and I'm a mom. So nice stressed out skin as well. I put this on whenever I notice my skin to start getting worse. Just pay attention to the time frame of 5 minutes and don't let it stay on longer, because it can actually hurt your skin. Received this as a sample and loved it so much, broke down and bought the full size. Definitely worth the money.

While I have tried many different mask products that have claimed to deliver results, I am almost always left disappointed and wishing I had the money back. That is, until I figured I would finally give this one a try. Keep my money! This mask exfoliates without being too rough, yet also leaves my skin feeling hydrated and healthy. I would definitely recommend giving this mask a try. Plus the texture and smell can't be beat!
Makes my skin feel so soft and I feel refreshed! Love this so much!
Best exfoliant after your wash!! Very rich and you only need a little amount. Love the color too!!
I use this every other day and definitely have noticed my face clearing. Feels nice after use!
I saw a lot of results with this treatment. My skin was glowing and I love the color of the mask. Definitely would recommend

avis.titre: Changed my skin after one use
avis.texte: Been battling COVID skin for the last several months- change in texture and breakouts like never before. And the ironic thing, I've been following my skin routine to the T! Until about 1.5-2 months of complete skincare change to Tula and this wonderful mask. Used the mask for the first time and wow my skin felt and looked so youthful (37yo with redness & mild breakouts.) It was like a dose of everything my skin needed combined with Tula's night/day cream and eye cream. Perfection.

i have the most sensitive, oily, acne prone skin ever and this is the best thing since sliced bread. makes my skin GLOW after i use it. i use maybe a nickel size amount of product and it covers my whole face. i use it twice a week and it's great. the beads in the mask leave my face super smooth too. definitely will be a product i keep in my skin routine from here on out!!
My skin feels incredibly soft after using it. Only once per week, though, otherwise it makes my skin too dry.
The best face mask I've ever used! My face has never felt so smooth, and it smells wonderful!
